title: Chapter 1461
text:
This was a deep and vast space, like a real universe. The black velvet curtain was dotted with green stars, dazzling.

Suddenly, a green light appeared out of thin air, spinning and expanding, turning into a wormhole-like vortex that spat out Han Xiao's figure.

Han Xiao quickly stabilized himself and turned to observe his surroundings curiously.

"Where did you bring me?"

He glanced at the interface, and the combat information showed his current status. He had been 'swallowed' by the Tree God, and this universe-like world was the inner space of the Tree God.

The next moment, Han Xiao immediately felt the repulsion of the entire world. The space around him was pressuring him, suppressing his strength. The Void Domain was squeezed to the point that it could only stick to the surface of the body, almost turning into a flat membrane.

At the same time, Han Xiao also discovered that an unknown corrosive force was continuously reducing his Health Points. In his status bar, it was displayed as' World Tree's digestive function '.

"So, I've fallen into the stomach of the World Tree."

Han Xiao thought to himself.

Buzz!

At this moment, the green light in front of Han Xiao shrank and condensed into the body of the Tree God. His injuries had already recovered, and he stood facing him from afar.

The Ancestral Tree King said with a deep voice, "Black Star, our battle is not over yet."

Han Xiao sized him up. "This is your inner space, right? You actually dared to suck me in. You're really not afraid of death."

Releasing the inner space domain did not have any side effects because it was just a projection of power, just like the descent of a secondary dimension … However, sucking the enemy into the inner space was the opposite. This was a dangerous operation. If the inner space itself was destroyed, the Transcendent would also be severely injured. It was equivalent to exposing his vitals to the opponent.

However, in the inner space, the enemy's strength would be greatly suppressed, and he would receive a higher buff. Therefore, this was a double-edged sword.

Even if Han Xiao was very tanky, he was not willing to suck any enemy into his body. This would only increase the risk. In his opinion, the Ancestral Tree King's move was undoubtedly a gamble, but it was not smart.

"If you don't die, the mother tree will never have a day of peace. This will be your death ground!"

The Ancestral Tree King's tone was ruthless, and he attacked again without hesitation.

Hualala — An endless stream of green light shot toward Han Xiao like a meteor shower.

Seeing this, Han Xiao lifted the emperor's robe, and a thick psionic shield blocked the dense rain of light.

At the same time, he ordered the Mech Legion to open fire. However, they did not attack the Tree God. Instead, they bombarded the Tree God in all directions, causing the energy clusters to expand.

Under normal circumstances, attacking the inner space was like turning the other party's body upside down, and the damage would be reflected back to the Tree God.

However, the next moment, something out of Han Xiao's expectations happened. The Tree God was not affected at all. Furthermore, it gave up all its defenses and attacked fiercely, as if it was not worried about its inner space being damaged at all.

Han Xiao was a little surprised. His Void Domain was suppressed, but the Tree God was like a fish in water in the inner space. His strength decreased, and he had no choice but to take a defensive stance.

"Interesting. Your inner space won't be damaged?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and observed the flow of energy while resisting the Ancestral Tree King's attacks.

Not long after, Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He noticed something and smiled.

"I see. I've roughly guessed it. Your inner space is connected to the World Tree and transferred all the damage, right?"

"…"

The Ancestral Tree King's heart tightened, but he did not answer. His attacks became even more intense.

The things that the World Tree devoured formed a 'mother tree world' in its body. There were also planets and lives, and most of them operated according to the state they were in when they were devoured. They would not increase or decrease naturally, and it was equivalent to a special 'exhibition hall'. If the members of the World Tree were unwilling to appear in the outside world, they would live in the mother tree world. The so-called transformation of the World Tree's body was like spitting something out of its body to the outside world.

The Tree God and the World Tree were closely connected, so the inner space was also connected to the mother tree world. Strictly speaking, the Tree God's inner space was a clone of the mother tree world. The Ancestral Tree King could distribute the damage to the Tree God's inner space to the mother tree world.

This way, the World Tree's main body would suffer a certain amount of damage, but the Tree God would not be injured and would be able to maintain its peak state … Under normal circumstances, the Ancestral Tree King would not let the World Tree's main body take such a risk, but now, increasing the Tree God's combat strength was more important, so he could only make a temporary choice.

Therefore, in order to prevent the World Tree's main body from suffering any further damage, the Ancestral Tree King chose to end the battle quickly. He had to get rid of this enemy before Han Xiao caused more damage to the inner space!

Seeing that Han Xiao had noticed his weakness so quickly, the Ancestral Tree King's expression changed, and he gritted his teeth.

"Even if I have to bet my future, I must kill you!"

As soon as he said that, the crown of the Fortitude Tree King shattered!

The powerful crown origin energy surged in, and the power of the Tree God soared once again!

Precise mechanical armor spread rapidly on the surface of the Tree God's body. At the same time, mechanical soldiers flickering with green light were generated on a large scale around the Tree God. This scene was like a Transcendent Grade Mechanic activating (Virtual Creation).

However, the Ancestral Tree King did not stop. He endured the pain and directly took over the allocation of resources for the 'King's Legacy' from the will of the mother tree.

The Sacrificial Tree Crown was a way to strengthen the Tree God, but it was not the only way. Among the abilities that Han Xiao had not seen, there were other ways to strengthen it, and investing more Beyonder's Vestige was another way.

If the Beyonder's Vestige was the 'firewood' that burned the power of the Tree God, adding more 'firewood' would naturally make the flames burn even brighter.

After so many years, generations of tree kings had failed to break through to the Transcendent Grade, and they had left behind some 'King's Relics'. They were strategic resources, and every time they were used, there would be one less.

Originally, he only needed to consume one portion each time he summoned the Tree God, but the Ancestral Tree King could not care less and directly burned half of his inventory!

Bang!

An intense energy tide spread out, and the energy level of the Tree God rose bit by bit. Rich and bright green waves surged as if they were going to fill the entire space.

"Good fellow, SEED again?!"

Han Xiao secretly bared his teeth.

This is too much. Are you a Saiyan … Oh no, a Saiyan Tree?!

After sacrificing three crowns and burning half of the Beyonder's Vestige, the combat strength of the Tree God soared to a higher level, and its combat style also changed. Other than using the basic skills of the World Tree, various magic, martial arts, and mechanical system methods formed an exquisite combination. One person was like an expert of three systems. It was very flashy, but its power was astonishing.

In an instant, the violent attacks pierced through the shield, leaving all kinds of wounds on the body of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate, and the devices were destroyed one after another.

"I still can't underestimate this guy. With the foundation of the World Tree Civilization, there's a lot of room for his combat strength to fluctuate …"

Han Xiao felt a lot of pressure from the Ancestral Tree King's attacks, and his heart skipped a beat.

If he had not sealed the Heart Tree Crown, the complete Tree God might have been able to completely suppress him after receiving so many enhancements.

However, the current Tree God was in an incomplete state, and its foundation was weakened. Thus, the effect of SEED was also reduced and could not reach its peak.

"What a pity. If this is your full strength, I won't be the one to die today."

Han Xiao's tone froze.

Boom!

Without waiting for the Ancestral Tree King to react, the energy level of the Supreme Heavenly Venerate suddenly increased explosively. In the blink of an eye, it caught up to the combat strength of the Tree God!

All kinds of strange abilities erupted one after another, stopping the Ancestral Tree King's attacks. Han Xiao immediately took back the initiative and counterattacked fiercely, turning the situation around in an instant.

The Ancestral Tree King's eyes widened. "You …"

"Tsk, do you think SEED is your patent?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. An endless stream of new energy fused into his body, bringing him an incomparable sense of strength. He almost felt like he could pierce through the universe.

The reason for this change was because he had used the Character Summon Cards in his inventory.

Ever since he had stepped into the peak Beyond Grade A realm, Han Xiao had not used the Character Summon Cards much. Because there was no need for it, he had a lot of stock in his hands.

Before this expedition, he had specially used all the blank Character Summon Cards to copy the abilities of different Beyond Grade As and a large amount of resources.

It was not easy for him to accumulate a large amount of wealth, and Han Xiao activated Character Summon Cards one after another without any heartache. He used almost everything he had. He only felt carefree and happy!

After scheming for so long, he finally had a chance to be extravagant!

Compared to the explosion of a small universe, I'm the expert!

Sensing that Black Star's combat strength had caught up again, the Ancestral Tree King's mind exploded.

Every time he managed to pull open a gap, he would be caught up in the end. Black Star's unfathomable trump card made the Ancestral Tree King, who was already emotionally unstable, completely go crazy!

"Black Star!"

Bang!

The last Tree King Crown exploded, and the Ancestral Tree King decisively sacrificed his crown!

He threw all his worries to the back of his mind and threw all the Beyonder's Vestige into the Tree God's body.

He pushed the power of the Tree God forward at all costs!

His strength increased at an astonishing speed, but at the same time, faint green cracks spread on the surface of the Tree God's body. The huge load was already at the limit of the Tree God.

The Tree God itself had a limit. It was like a container. When the accumulated power exceeded the maximum capacity, it would burst from the inside.

Perhaps in its perfect state, the capacity of the Tree God could withstand the current power, but the incomplete Tree God was like a smaller container. It could not withstand such a load, and its injuries began to accumulate rapidly.

However, the Ancestral Tree King ignored the overload situation and launched an indomitable attack at Han Xiao with his explosive strength.

At this moment, he only had one thought left, and that was to kill Black Star!

"Come!"

Han Xiao was full of fighting spirit as he charged forward.

Bang bang bang bang!

The two of them overflowed with terrifying power. They only attacked and did not defend, bombarding each other countless times. The energy collided, forming an extremely dense explosive area. Here, spacetime was distorted, almost condensing into a singularity.

The two of them abandoned all distracting thoughts. All that was left in their eyes was their opponent. They attacked tirelessly, and the battlefield traveled throughout the universe.

Space trembled and shattered. The starlight dimmed and fell!

The battle lasted for an unknown period of time, as if it was an eternity. Only then did this battle come to an end.

Burning the Beyonder's Vestige was the only way to maintain the existence of the Tree God. The Tree God was finally exhausted, and the power obtained from the Seed Explosion rapidly weakened. The Tree God's body was already covered in cracks from the overload, like a porcelain piece that had been pieced together after being broken.

Crack!

The Tree God's chest suddenly split open, causing a chain reaction. With its chest as the center, its entire body 'collapsed', turning into light fragments that filled the sky.

This scene represented the death of the Tree God.

The Tree God was also alive. Once it was killed, the fused Tree King would also be severely injured, and the Tree God's Descent would be on cooldown for a long time … In addition, because the four Tree King crowns had been sacrificed, the World Tree could no longer summon the Tree God.

In the sky filled with light fragments, the Ancestral Tree King's body floated. He seemed to have exhausted all his lifespan, becoming old and wrinkled.

As the Tree God collapsed, the Ancestral Tree King also slowly turned into ashes. His life was like a candle in the wind.

"I lost … I'm sorry, Mother Tree. I let you down … I was so close. I'm not willing …"

The Ancestral Tree King's consciousness gradually dissipated as he muttered to himself.

Han Xiao still did not relax. He received the Ancestral Tree King's intermittent brainwaves and clicked his tongue.

"What do you mean by almost? From the beginning to the end, you had no chance of winning."

The Ancestral Tree King turned around and glared at Han Xiao.

"… I did not save my civilization, but sooner or later, you will taste the despair that I am feeling right now! I curse you … "

"Don't look like you have a deep grudge. When you destroy other civilizations, you should be mentally prepared to be destroyed by others."

Han Xiao did not have the mood to talk nonsense with him. He reached out and grabbed the Ancestral Tree King.

Pu!

The Ancestral Tree King was crushed into dust and disappeared. His consciousness completely fell into darkness.

Han Xiao was not interested in waiting for him to die slowly. He was not a villain who did not know how to deal the final blow.

Because of the World Tree's operation, the Ancestral Tree King had lost his ability to revive. If he died in this state, he would really die and disappear.

"I've finally dealt with him. Good fellow, he almost drained me dry."

Only at this moment did Han Xiao finally relax. He was extremely tired.

Although he had won this battle, Han Xiao was also very tired. In the final stage, the Tree God seemed to have activated the Freedom Mastery Technique. It was so ferocious that it almost shattered his Supreme Heavenly Venerate mecha several times.

Strictly speaking, the one who killed the Tree God was not Han Xiao but the Ancestral Tree King himself. The damage caused by the overload and the burning of the Beyonder's Vestige was the main reason why the Tree God was exhausted.

If the Tree God was in a perfect state with all five crowns gathered, Han Xiao felt that he would not be a match for him.

Unfortunately, there were no ifs in this world.

Crack! Crack!

The moment the Tree God completely died, the inner space began to collapse rapidly and crack open like a broken mirror. Dazzling light flowed through every crack, all leading to the outside world.

Han Xiao calmed himself down and kept the severely damaged Mech Legion back into the Divine Fortress. He then drove the huge Supreme Heavenly Venerate into one of the cracks and disappeared into the light.

(End of Chapter)
